commands.command:
set -euo pipefail
SEL='192.168.0.100:46769'
adb start-server >/dev/null
adb connect "$SEL" >/dev/null
test "$(adb -s "$SEL" shell getprop ro.product.model | tr -d '\r')" = 'SM-S906B'
test "$(adb -s "$SEL" shell getprop ro.serialno | tr -d '\r')" = 'RFCT70L7E8J'
echo '--- version ---'
adb -s "$SEL" shell dumpsys package moe.shizuku.privileged.api | grep -E 'versionName=|versionCode=' | head -4 || true
echo '--- package paths ---'
adb -s "$SEL" shell pm path moe.shizuku.privileged.api
echo '--- components matching starter/service ---'
adb -s "$SEL" shell dumpsys package moe.shizuku.privileged.api | grep -Ei 'starter|service|receiver|provider|mainactivity' | head -120 || true
echo '--- process check before ---'
adb -s "$SEL" shell ps -A | grep -i shizuku || true
